The '''Teagan Tech Consortium''' was a company that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Teagan]] during the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The Consortium created the [[RWW-series protocol droid]], to allow the [[Devon]], a group that was native to Teagan, to interact with visitors to their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="SGtD" />
